name: Session time limits
description: Disconnects an idle session after the idle limit and signs out a disconnected session after the disconnected limit, by writing the computer policy values MaxIdleTime and MaxDisconnectionTime (milliseconds). A platform script is used because the Administrative Template only offers fixed values (for example 1 or 2 hours), not 90 minutes.
portalPath: Intune admin center > Devices > Scripts and remediations > Platform scripts > Add > Windows 10 and later: upload Set-SessionTimeLimits.ps1, run as system (Run this script using the logged on credentials = No), 64-bit, no signature check
reviewNotes: Set the minutes with $SessionIdleLimitMinutes and $SessionDisconnectedLimitMinutes before deploying (defaults 90 and 180). The deploy script writes them into the uploaded script.
Applies from the user's next connection or sign-in.

If you'd rather use the settings catalog, the same settings are under Administrative templates > Windows Components > Remote Desktop Services > Remote Desktop Session Host > Session Time Limits, with fixed choices only.
